preserved: Divine addressee uses devotional speech; crew orders and internal deliberation change addressee/register inside the same record.
Player deity impersonation remains imperative. The Ilwrath select Thraddash after the general seek-new-prey instruction; the player line does not name a target.
Self-mutilation, victim descriptions and religious cruelty retain the original scope without added acts or narrator approval.
Channel 44, 44 eyes/planes/tongues/cilia, 42 crew plus omnipresent two gods, 29 years, nearly eight years and 022.9, 366.6 remain intact.
Broken cloaking device, missing crew and replenishment motivate the initial encounter; they are not generalized to every Ilwrath ship.
No longer needing guidance and their social definition of evil remain the speakers self-serving contradictions, not resolved explanations.
Source wordplay request/response pairs remain consistent with translations/wordplay.ko.json; Dogar/Kazon are not replaced by the players deliberate misnamings.
Original IDs, order, line boundaries and speaker turns remain unchanged.
